The '''Velossia system''' was located in the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Velossian caramachi shell-back]]s.<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Velossia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-15.<ref name="TEA" />
